scenarios.title: Generate job application notification between two accounts

steps.step_text: And I navigate to the Job Application page
And I select a job from the available list
And I click on Apply for Job
Then I see a notification message saying "Job application submitted successfully"

scenarios.title: Generate selection notification between two accounts

steps.step_text: And I navigate to the Job Application page
And I select a job from the available list
And I click on Apply for Job
And I navigate to the Job Management page
And I select the job I applied for
And I click on Select Job
Then I see a notification message saying "Job selected successfully"

scenarios.title: Generate acceptance notification between two accounts

steps.step_text: And I navigate to the Job Management page
And I select the job I applied for
And I click on Select Job
And I navigate to the Job Application page
And I select the job I applied for
And I click on Accept Job
Then I see a notification message saying "Job accepted successfully"

scenarios.title: Generate tender quote notification between two accounts

steps.step_text: And I navigate to the Tender Management page
And I select a tender from the available list
And I click on Submit Quote
Then I see a notification message saying "Quote submitted successfully"

scenarios.title: Generate message notification between two accounts

steps.step_text: And I navigate to the Message page
And I select a recipient from the available list
And I enter a message in the message box
And I click on Send Message
Then I see a notification message saying "Message sent successfully"

scenarios.title: Generate availability activity notification between two accounts

steps.step_text: And I navigate to the Availability page
And I select a date and time for availability
And I click on List Availability
Then I see a notification message saying "Availability listed successfully"
